name: C.J. Cohick
office: Glendora Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: C.J. Cohick is a product manager running for the Glendora Unified School District Governing Board, Trustee Area No. 2.

sentences.text: C.J. Cohick is a product manager running for the Glendora Unified School District Governing Board, Trustee Area No. 2.

items.text: In his campaign questionnaire, he named enrollment decline and its budget impact, and trust between Glendora families and the district, as the district's top two needs. He said Glendora Unified has lost students five years in a row, more than 350 since 2021. He said enrollment is nearly 1,500 below its peak and expected to drop by another 200 over two years. His campaign highlights his background building AI products and says he reads budget reports and asks hard questions. His campaign says preparing kids is about character more than new apps.
